Disclaimer
0. Cannot guarantee there are no bugs.
1. The protection boundary of this feature only includes encrypted storage, on-demand authentication, and memory cleanup after use; it does not constitute an absolute security guarantee.
2. Under root / posed / hook / debugger / malicious input method environments, passwords may still leak.
3. This feature does not bypass system lock screen authentication; it is only for devices you have legally authorized control over.
4. Disabling "Require authentication when filling passwords" will significantly reduce security; please choose carefully
